Author: Iam Batman
Name: Faloop Messenger
Punchline: Live S-rank hunt tracker from Faloop, with one-click teleport via Lifestream.
Description: Connects to Faloop's real-time websocket feed and shows S-rank spawn cards with a zoomed map preview and route hints. Echoes new spawns to chat with a clickable map link, plays a sound, and lets you teleport to the closest aetheryte (cross-world, via Lifestream). Commands: /faloop (full tracker), /faloopmini (slim auto-popping window), /faloopcompact (high-density view).
